headings: Analytics and Insights. Our analytics and insights tools improve data quality and provide data intelligence to optimize the end-to-end tax process and improve business outcomes.
paragraphs: Vertex is a leading provider of enterprise compliance technology for global commerce. Our software, data, and services help businesses operate with confidence by automating and governing transaction-based compliance obligations that arise wherever they buy, sell, and move goods and services around the world.

At the core of global commerce are transaction-based regulatory requirements that must be calculated, documented, reported, and, in many cases, digitally transmitted to tax authorities in real time. Indirect taxes—such as sales tax, use tax, and value-added tax ("VAT")—represent a significant portion of these obligations. Unlike direct taxes, which are paid directly by the entity being taxed, indirect taxes are collected from a purchaser and remitted to taxing authorities by the seller or service provider as part of each transaction.

These obligations are inherently complex and pervasive. In the United States alone, indirect tax rules vary across more than 20,000 unique taxing jurisdictions, each with its own rates, rules, and reporting requirements. Globally, the complexity is compounded by continuously changing regulations, increasing enforcement, and the growing adoption of digital and real-time compliance mandates. For companies operating across multiple jurisdictions, compliance is not an isolated, periodic activity—it is a requirement embedded in virtually every sale or purchase transaction they execute each day.

Vertex helps enterprises manage this complexity by embedding compliance automation directly into the systems and workflows that drive global commerce. Our platform enables customers to determine transaction-level obligations, manage compliance data, support invoicing and reporting requirements, and maintain audit-ready records across jurisdictions. By reducing friction, enhancing transparency, and improving control, Vertex helps customers mitigate the risk of non-compliance while supporting business growth and operational scalability.

The pace of change in global business, technology, and regulatory environments continues to increase. As companies expand into new geographies, adopt new distribution and eCommerce models, introduce digital products and services, and modernize their technology stacks, their exposure to transaction-based compliance obligations grows significantly. At the same time, governments are increasingly implementing new tax rules and digital reporting requirements to improve transparency and enforcement. These dynamics demand intelligent, scalable solutions that allow businesses to satisfy regulatory obligations while continuing to innovate and grow.

Vertex has pioneered tax and compliance technology for more than 45 years. Today, we serve over 4,800 direct customers, including the majority of the Fortune 500, and support compliance operations in more than 195 countries and territories. Our software delivers capabilities across transaction determination, compliance and reporting, tax data and document management, and analytics and insights, supported by deep integrations with the core enterprise applications that power global commerce. Our platform is fueled by more than one billion data-driven tax rates and rules and supports compliance across more than 20,000 jurisdictions worldwide. Vertex solutions can be deployed in cloud and hybrid environments, with implementation and professional services available to support our customers' unique business and operational requirements.

Vertex's solutions help enterprises automate and govern transaction-based compliance across global commerce. Our platform supports the full lifecycle of indirect tax obligations, including transaction determination, digital invoicing and reporting requirements, compliance and returns, tax data and document management, and analytics and insights, all supported by pre-built integrations to leading enterprise business applications. Customers can deploy these capabilities individually or as an integrated suite on the Vertex cloud platform, or select deployment models that align with their broader enterprise technology environments.

Tax Calculation. The increasing complexity of global regulations, cross-border trade, and jurisdictional differences has made accurate tax determination a cornerstone of compliance. Our tax determination solutions enable real-time calculation of indirect taxes and applicable fees for sale and purchase transactions. Our solution includes a powerful indirect tax calculation engine that applies rules-based logic from our proprietary content database to determine taxability, identify precise taxing jurisdictions, and consistently apply the appropriate amount of tax to each transaction in real-time. Our solution supports determination for sales tax, consumer and seller use tax, VAT, communications tax, leasing tax, payroll tax, and lodging and occupancy tax, as well as a growing set of transaction-based fees imposed by various jurisdictions. With local rules and logic to ensure compliance globally, our tax engine is built to handle thousands of product stock keeping units ("SKUs") and services across a wide range of industries and business models.

Vertex AI. Vertex AI powers intelligence across the Vertex platform to help customers operate more efficiently, reduce risk, and improve decision-making across the compliance lifecycle. Embedded directly into transaction, configuration, and compliance workflows, Vertex AI is designed to automate routine work, surface relevant insights earlier, and guide users toward better outcomes with less manual effort. By learning from patterns across tax data, content changes, and customer activity, Vertex AI helps tax teams scale their operations, respond more quickly to regulatory change, and focus their expertise where it matters most.

Vertex AI operates across the full compliance lifecycle, supporting activities such as transaction determination, tax content interpretation, configuration management, and ongoing monitoring. Rather than requiring customers to adopt separate tools or processes, Vertex AI is integrated into the Vertex cloud platform to enhance existing workflows—automating tasks, identifying potential risks or changes that may impact tax outcomes, and delivering recommendations tailored to specific roles, tasks, or business contexts.

Vertex's AI capabilities include intelligent assistance for tax professionals, automated analysis of tax content changes to identify potential impacts to product taxability or configuration, and natural-language driven tools that simplify the creation and management of tax rules. Together, these capabilities are designed to reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and help customers maintain compliance in an environment of constantly changing regulations.

In addition to platform-embedded AI capabilities, in 2025, Vertex launched Smart Categorization, an AI-powered solution designed to reduce the manual effort required to map product SKUs to the correct tax categories across jurisdictions. Smart Categorization helps retail tax teams improve accuracy and efficiency by learning from historical classification patterns and applying them consistently at scale, reducing the time and resources required to maintain product taxability mappings as catalogs and regulations change.

Pre-Built Integrations. Our solutions are supported by a suite of powerful, pre-built integrations that enable real-time coordination between our solutions and major business applications, such as Adobe/Magento, Coupa, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, Oracle, Salesforce, SAP, SAP Ariba, Shopify, Workday, and Zuora, among many others. Much more than traditional application programming interfaces, our integrations include mapping data fields, business logic and configurations to improve the processing of transactions to and from our solutions. The majority of our integrations are designed, tested, and supported by us. We also allow for partner-developed integrations as part of a rigorous certification program.

Industry-Specific Solutions. We offer a range of solutions that support certain industries that have specific indirect tax needs, such as retail, communications, and leasing. For example, our retail solution supports omnichannel transactions spanning store kiosks, eCommerce websites, catalog sales, and mobile device transactions. Our communications solution supports the determination of taxes, surcharges, and fees affecting U.S. providers of communication services, including wireless, voice-over-IP, satellite, internet, and video and audio streaming services. We have pre-built integrations specific to the leading providers of business applications used in these industries.

Vertex is a leading provider of enterprise compliance technology for global commerce. Our software, data, and services help businesses operate with confidence by automating and governing transaction-based compliance obligations that arise wherever they buy, sell, and move goods and services around the world. Our mission is to deliver the most trusted tax technology enabling global businesses to transact, comply, and grow with confidence. Vertex provides cloud-based and on-premise solutions that can be tailored to specific industries for every major line of indirect tax, including sales and consumer use, value added (including e-invoicing), and payroll. Headquartered in North America, and with offices in South America and Europe, Vertex employs over 2,100 professionals and serves companies across the globe.

We derive the majority of our revenue from software subscriptions. These subscriptions include use of our software and ongoing monthly content updates. Our software is offered on a subscription basis to our customers, regardless of their deployment preferences. On-premise subscriptions and cloud-based subscriptions are typically sold through one- to three-year contracts. We bill the majority of our customers annually in advance of the subscription period.

Our customers include a majority of the Fortune 500, as well as a majority of the top 10 companies by revenue in multiple industries such as retail, technology, and manufacturing, in addition to leading marketplaces. Our customer base also includes many of Europe's largest companies in the industrial and chemical manufacturing, pharmaceutical, medical device and metals and mining industries. As our customers expand geographically and pursue omnichannel business models, their tax determination and compliance requirements increase and become more complex, providing sustainable organic growth opportunities for our business. Our flexible, tiered transaction-based pricing model also results in our customers growing their spend with us as they grow and continue to use our solutions. We principally price our solutions based on a customer's revenue base, in addition to a number of other factors.

We employ a hybrid deployment model to align to our customers' technology preferences for their core financial management software across on-premise, cloud deployments, or any combination of these models. Over time, we expect both existing and newly acquired customers to continue to shift toward cloud deployment models. Cloud-based subscription sales to new customers have grown at a significantly faster rate than on-premise software subscription sales, which is a trend that we expect to continue over time. We generated 55% and 49% of software subscription revenues from cloud-based subscriptions in 2025 and 2024, respectively. While our on-premise software subscription revenues comprised 45% and 51% of our software subscription revenues for 2025 and 2024, respectively, they continue to decrease as a percentage of total software subscriptions revenues as cloud-based subscriptions grow.

We license our solutions primarily through our direct sales force, which focuses on selling to qualified leads provided by our marketing efforts, and through our network of referral partners. We also utilize indirect sales to a lesser extent to efficiently grow and scale our enterprise and mid-market revenues.

Our partner ecosystem is a differentiating, competitive strength in both our software development and our sales and marketing activities. We integrate with key technology partners that span ERP, CRM, procurement, billing, POS, and eCommerce. These partners include Adobe/Magento, Coupa, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, Oracle, Salesforce, SAP, SAP Ariba, Shopify, Workday, and Zuora. In 2025, we partnered with Kintsugi to launch Kintsugi powered by Vertex,

which enables small- and medium-sized businesses to automate key compliance functions while providing real-time dashboards for jurisdictional liability and exposure tracking. We also collaborate with over 45 accounting and professional services firms who have built implementation practices around our software to serve their customer base.

We believe that global commerce and the compliance environment provide durable and accelerating growth opportunities for our business. We generated revenues of $748.4 million and $666.8 million in 2025 and 2024, respectively. We had net income (loss) of $7.2 million and $(52.7) million in 2025 and 2024, respectively. These amounts are presented in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles in the U.S. ("GAAP").

We define Adjusted EBITDA as net income or loss before interest (including adjustments to the settlement value of deferred purchase commitment liabilities), income tax expense or benefit, depreciation, and amortization, as adjusted to exclude charges for stock-based compensation expense, amortization of cloud computing arrangement implementation costs, severance expense, acquisition contingent consideration, changes in the fair value of acquisition contingent earn-outs, changes in the settlement value of deferred purchase commitment liabilities recorded as interest expense, and transaction costs. Adjusted EBITDA was $161.5 million and $151.9 million in 2025 and 2024, respectively. Adjusted EBITDA is a non-GAAP financial measure. Refer to "Key Business Metrics" and "Use and Reconciliation of Non-GAAP Financial Measures" for further discussion of key business metrics and non-GAAP financial measures and their comparison to GAAP financial measures.

The growth of our business and our future success depends on many factors, including our ability to retain and expand our revenues from existing customers, acquire new customers, broaden and deepen our partner ecosystem, continually innovate our software, invest in growth and scale our business, and manage customer migrations to cloud solutions. While these areas represent significant opportunities for us, we also face significant risks and challenges that we must successfully address in order to sustain the growth of our business and improve our operating results. We anticipate that we will continue to expand our operations and headcount. The expected addition of new personnel and the investments that we anticipate will be necessary to manage our anticipated growth may make it more difficult for us to achieve or maintain profitability. Many of these investments will occur in advance of experiencing any direct benefit and will make it difficult to determine if we are allocating our resources efficiently.

Retention and expansion of revenues from existing customers. Given the breadth of our customer base and their own internal growth, the majority of our revenues and revenue growth comes from existing customers. This revenue growth is comprised of the acquisition of new licenses for additional products, increases in subscription fees due to expanded usage of currently licensed software and price increases. We plan to continue to invest in new innovations and offerings and in our sales and marketing teams in order to support the ongoing strong retention and expansion of revenues with our existing customers. We continually invest in and focus on elevating and delivering exceptional experiences for our customers, while aiming to build strong, long-term relationships with them. We monitor our net revenue retention rate ("NRR") in order to understand our ability to retain and grow revenues from our customers. Our NRR was 105% and 109% in 2025 and 2024, respectively. We believe our gross revenue retention rate ("GRR") provides insight into and demonstrates to investors our ability to retain revenues from our existing customers. Our GRR was 94% and 95% in 2025 and 2024, respectively. Refer to "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations– Key Business Metrics– Net Revenue Retention Rate and Gross Revenue Retention Rate" and for further discussion.

Acquire new customers. Our solutions address the complexity of aligning commerce and compliance, and we believe the market for our software and solutions is large and underpenetrated, both in the U.S. and globally. As enterprise and mid-market companies continue to expand their business operations—both through their product and service offerings and their global footprint—we expect demand for our tax and e-invoicing solutions to increase due to the fact that legacy solutions such as spreadsheets, manual processes, native ERP functionality, or home-built solutions are error prone, inefficient, and cannot scale. We plan to continue to invest in our sales and marketing teams and our solution development in order to address this increased demand from new customers. This increased investment will result in increases in expenses in advance of revenues attributable to these investments.

headings: 分析與見解。我們的分析與見解工具提升資料品質，並提供資料智慧以優化端到端稅務流程，並改善業務成果。
paragraphs: Vertex 是全球商業企業合規科技的領導供應商。我們的軟體、資料與服務協助企業以信心運作，透過自動化與管理交易基準的合規義務，這些義務會出現在他們在全球買賣與移動商品與服務的每個場合。
全球商業的核心是交易基準的法規要求，必須計算、記錄、報告，並在許多情況下，以數位方式實時傳送至稅務機關。間接稅—例如銷售稅、使用稅與價值增加稅（"VAT"）—代表這些義務的重要部分。與直接稅不同，直接稅是由被課稅的實體直接支付，間接稅則是由買方收取，並由賣方或服務提供者在每次交易中轉交至稅務機關。
這些義務本質上是複雜且廣泛存在的。僅美國一地，間接稅規則就跨過超過 20,000 個獨特的稅收管轄區域，每個區域都有自己的稅率、規則與報告要求。在全球範圍內，複雜性更因持續變動的法規、增加的執法力度，以及數位與實時合規義務的廣泛採用而增加。對在多個管轄區域運作的企業而言，合規並不是孤立的、週期性的活動—而是嵌入在他們每天執行的幾乎每一筆買賣交易中。
Vertex 藉由將合規自動化直接嵌入驅動全球商業的系統與作業流程，協助企業管理這項複雜性。我們的平台讓客戶能判斷交易層面的義務、管理合規資料、支援發票與報告需求，並在各管轄區域維護備查就緒的記錄。透過減少摩擦、提高透明度與改善控制，Vertex 協助客戶降低非合規風險，同時支持業務成長與作業規模的擴張。
全球商業、科技與法規環境的變動速度持續加快。當企業擴展至新地理區域、採用新分銷與電商模式、推出數位產品與服務，並現代化其科技架構時，他們面對交易基準合規義務的風險顯著增加。同時，政府正 increasingly 落實新的稅收規則與數位報告要求，以提高透明度與執法力度。這些動態需求智慧化、可擴展的解決方案，讓企業在持續創新與成長的同時，滿足法規義務。

Vertex 自 45 年前便先驅開發稅務與合規科技。目前，我們服務超過 4,800 個直接客戶，包括大多數的《財富》500 大企業，並支援在超過 195 個國家與地區的合規作業。我們的軟體提供交易判斷、合規與報告、稅務資料與文件管理，以及分析與洞察等能力，並透過與驅動全球商業的核心企業應用程式深度整合。我們的平台由超過十億筆資料驅動的稅率與規則所支援，並可支援全球超過 20,000 個管轄區域的合規作業。Vertex 解決方案可部署於雲端與混合環境，並提供實施與專業服務，以支援客戶獨特的業務與作業需求。
Vertex 的解決方案協助企業自動化與管理全球商業中的交易基準合規。我們的平台支援間接稅義務的完整生命週期，包括交易判斷、數位發票與報告需求、合規與報稅、稅務資料與文件管理，以及分析與洞察，所有功能皆透過與領先企業業務應用程式的預建整合支援。客戶可選擇單獨部署這些功能，或作為整合套件在 Vertex 雲端平台部署，或選擇符合其企業科技環境的部署模式。

稅務計算。全球法規、跨境貿易與管轄區域差異的日益複雜，使得準確的稅務判斷成為合規的基石。我們的稅務判斷解決方案可實時計算銷售與購買交易的間接稅與適用費用。我們的解決方案包含強大的間接稅計算引擎，透過我們專屬內容資料庫的規則邏輯，判斷稅務適用性、識別精確的稅收管轄區域，並在實時中一致地應用正確的稅額至每筆交易。我們的解決方案支援銷售稅、消費者與賣方使用稅、VAT、通訊稅、租賃稅、薪資稅，以及住宿與佔用稅，以及各管轄區域日益增加的交易基準費用。透過本地規則與邏輯確保全球合規，我們的稅務引擎可處理數千種產品庫存單位（"SKUs"）與服務，適用於廣泛的產業與商業模式。

Vertex AI. Vertex AI 透過 Vertex 平台提供智慧功能，協助客戶提高運作效率、降低風險，並改善合規流程中的決策。Vertex AI 直接嵌入交易、設定及合規作業流程中，設計用以自動化常規工作、更早提供相關見解，並以較少的手動努力引導使用者取得更好的結果。透過學習稅務資料、內容變更及客戶活動的模式，Vertex AI 協助稅務團隊擴大運作規模、更快回應法規變動，並將專業知識集中在最重要的領域。
Vertex AI 覆蓋完整的合規生命週期，支援交易判斷、稅務內容解釋、設定管理及持續監測等活動。Vertex AI 不需要客戶採用不同的工具或流程，而是整合至 Vertex 雲端平台中，以增強現有作業流程—自動化任務、識別可能影響稅務結果的潛在風險或變動，並提供針對特定角色、任務或業務情境的建議。
Vertex 的 AI 能力包括為稅務專業人士提供智慧協助、自動分析稅務內容變動以識別可能影響產品課稅性質或設定的潛在影響，以及以自然語言驅動的工具簡化稅務規則的建立與管理。這些能力共同設計用以減少手動努力、提高一致性，並協助客戶在不斷變動的法規環境中維持合規。
除了平台內建的 AI 能力，Vertex 於 2025 年推出了 Smart Categorization，這是一項 AI 驅動的解決方案，設計用以減少將產品 SKU 映射至正確稅務類別所需的_manual_努力。Smart Categorization 協助零售稅務團隊提高準確性與效率，透過學習歷史分類模式並在規模上一致應用，減少維護產品課稅性質對應所需的時間與資源，隨著目錄與法規變動而更新。

Pre-Built Integrations. 我們的解決方案由一套強大且預先建置的整合方案支援，這些整合方案可實現我們的解決方案與主要業務應用程式之間的即時協調，例如 Adobe/Magento、Coupa、Microsoft Dynamics、NetSuite、Oracle、Salesforce、SAP、SAP Ariba、Shopify、Workday 和 Zuora 等。這些整合方案遠超過傳統的應用程式程式設計介面，包含資料欄位映射、業務邏輯與設定，以提高與我們解決方案之間交易的處理效率。我們的整合方案大多由我們設計、測試與支援。我們也允許由合作夥伴開發的整合方案，作為嚴格認證計畫的一部分。

Industry-Specific Solutions. 我們提供一系列解決方案，支援某些具有特定間接稅需求的產業，例如零售、通訊與租賃。例如，我們的零售解決方案支援跨商店服務臺、電子商務網站、目錄銷售與行動裝置交易的全通路交易。我們的通訊解決方案支援判斷影響美國通訊服務提供者的稅務、附加費與費用，包括無線、語音通訊、衛星、網路與視訊與音訊串流服務。我們為這些產業中使用的領先業務應用程式提供預先建置的整合方案。

paragraphs: 您應配合本年度報表（Form 10-K）所附的合併財務報表及其附註，閱讀下列對本公司財務狀況與營運成果的討論與分析。除了歷史財務資訊外，下列討論包含向前看的陳述，反映本公司計畫、預估、信念與預期，這些陳述涉及風險與不確定性。本公司實際結果與事件的時程可能與向前看陳述中所討論者有重大差異。導致這些差異的因素包括下列所討論的內容，以及本年度報表（Form 10-K）其他部分，特別是在「風險因素」與「向前看陳述特別說明」標題下的部分。

本年度報表（Form 10-K）的此部分一般討論 2025 年與 2024 年的項目，以及 2025 年與 2024 年的年對年比較。2023 年的項目與 2024 年與 2023 年的年對年比較未包含於本年度報表（Form 10-K）中，可於本公司 2024 年 12 月 31 日為結算日的年度報表（Form 10-K）「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果的討論與分析」（Part II, Item 7）中找到。

Vertex 是全球貿易企業合規科技的領導供應商。我們的軟體、資料與服務協助企業以信心運作，透過自動化與管理交易相關的合規義務，這些義務出現在他們在全球買賣與移動商品與服務的每個地方。我們的使命是提供最受信賴的稅務科技，使全球企業能以信心進行交易、合規與成長。Vertex 提供雲端與本地部署的解決方案，可針對各主要間接稅類別進行客製化，包括銷售與消費者使用稅、增值稅（含電子發票）、以及薪資稅。總部設於北美，並在南美與歐洲設有辦事處，Vertex 僱用超過 2,100 名專業人員，服務全球企業。
我們的收入主要來自軟體訂閱。這些訂閱包含軟體的使用與持續每月內容更新。我們的軟體以訂閱方式提供給客戶，不論其部署偏好為何。本地部署與雲端部署的訂閱通常透過一至三年的合約銷售。我們對大多數客戶以訂閱期間前的年度預付方式發票。

我們的客戶包括大多數《財富》500 強企業，以及零售、科技與製造業中按收入排名前 10 的企業，此外也包括主要的市場平台。我們的客戶羣體也包含歐洲工業與化學製造、藥品、醫療器材與金屬與礦業等行業中的一些最大企業。隨著客戶擴展地理範圍並採用全通路商業模式，他們的稅務判斷與合規需求增加且變得更複雜，為我們的業務提供可持續的內生成長機會。我們的靈活、分層的交易基準定價模式也使客戶在成長並持續使用我們的解決方案時，增加與我們的交易金額。我們主要根據客戶的營收規模來定價解決方案，同時也考量其他多種因素。

我們採用混合部署模式，以符合客戶對其核心財務管理軟體的技術偏好，包括本地部署、雲端部署，或任何這些模式的組合。隨著時間推移，我們預期現有與新近取得的客戶會持續轉向雲端部署模式。雲端訂閱銷售至新客戶的成長速度遠高於本地部署軟體訂閱銷售，這是我們預期會持續的趨勢。我們在 2025 年與 2024 年分別從雲端訂閱取得 55% 與 49% 的軟體訂閱收入。雖然我們的本地部署軟體訂閱收入在 2025 年與 2024 年分別佔軟體訂閱收入的 45% 與 51%，但這些收入在總軟體訂閱收入中所佔比例持續下降，因雲端訂閱收入持續成長。
我們主要透過直接銷售團隊來授權解決方案，該團隊專注於銷售給由我們行銷活動提供的合格潛在客戶，並透過我們的推薦合作夥伴網路。我們也有限度地使用間接銷售，以有效擴張與規模我們的企業與中型市場收入。

我們的合作夥伴生態系是我們軟體開發與銷售與行銷活動中的一項區隔性、競爭優勢。我們與關鍵科技合作夥伴整合，這些合作夥伴涵蓋 ERP、CRM、採購、發票、POS 與電子商務。這些合作夥伴包括 Adobe/Magento、Coupa、Microsoft Dynamics、NetSuite、Oracle、Salesforce、SAP、SAP Ariba、Shopify、Workday 與 Zuora。在 2025 年，我們與 Kintsugi 合作，推出 Kintsugi powered by Vertex。

We also collaborate with over 45 accounting and professional services firms who have built implementation practices around our software to serve their customer base.

We believe that global commerce and the compliance environment provide durable and accelerating growth opportunities for our business. We generated revenues of 748.4 百萬美元 and 666.8 百萬美元 in 2025 and 2024, respectively. We had net income (loss) of 7.2 百萬美元 and $(52.7) 百萬美元 in 2025 and 2024, respectively. These amounts are presented in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles in the U.S. ("GAAP").

We define Adjusted EBITDA as net income or loss before interest (including adjustments to the settlement value of deferred purchase commitment liabilities), income tax expense or benefit, depreciation, and amortization, as adjusted to exclude charges for stock-based compensation expense, amortization of cloud computing arrangement implementation costs, severance expense, acquisition contingent consideration, changes in the fair value of acquisition contingent earn-outs, changes in the settlement value of deferred purchase commitment liabilities recorded as interest expense, and transaction costs. Adjusted EBITDA was 161.5 百萬美元 and 151.9 百萬美元 in 2025 and 2024, respectively. Adjusted EBITDA is a non-GAAP financial measure. Refer to "Key Business Metrics" and "Use and Reconciliation of Non-GAAP Financial Measures" for further discussion of key business metrics and non-GAAP financial measures and their comparison to GAAP financial measures.

本公司業務的成長與未來成功取決於許多因素，包括本公司維持並擴大來自現有客戶的收入能力、取得新客戶、拓展並深化夥伴生態系統、持續創新軟體、投資於成長與擴充業務、以及管理客戶遷移至雲端解決方案。雖然這些領域代表了我們的重大機會，但我們同時也面臨許多重大風險與挑戰，必須成功應對，以維持業務成長並改善營運成果。我們預期將持續擴充業務運作與人力。預期新增的人力與我們預期將需要進行的投資，可能使我們更難以達成或維持獲利。許多這些投資將在獲得任何直接效益之前進行，並使我們難以判斷是否有效地配置資源。

維持並擴大來自現有客戶的收入。根據我們客戶羣的廣度及其自身內部成長，我們絕大多數的收入與收入成長來自現有客戶。此收入成長包含取得新授權以使用額外產品、因目前授權軟體使用量擴張而導致的訂閱費增加，以及價格上漲。我們計畫持續投資於新創新與產品，以及銷售與行銷團隊，以支持與現有客戶持續強勁的收入維持與擴張。我們持續投資並專注於提升並提供卓越的客戶體驗，同時致力於與客戶建立強而長遠的關係。我們監測淨收入留存率（"NRR"），以瞭解我們維持並成長來自客戶收入的能力。我們的 NRR 在 2025 年為 105%，在 2024 年為 109%。我們相信我們的毛收入留存率（"GRR"）能提供見解並向投資者展示我們維持來自現有客戶收入的能力。我們的 GRR 在 2025 年為 94%，在 2024 年為 95%。請參閱 "管理層討論與分析財務狀況與營運成果–關鍵業務指標–淨收入留存率與毛收入留存率" 並進一步討論。

取得新客戶。我們的解決方案針對對齊商業與合規的複雜性，我們相信我們軟體與解決方案的市場規模龐大且尚未充分開發，不僅在美國，也在全球範圍內。隨著企業與中型市場公司持續擴展其業務運作—透過其產品與服務提供以及全球足跡—我們預期對我們稅務與電子發票解決方案的需求將增加，這是因為傳統解決方案如試算表、手動流程、原生 ERP 功能或自建解決方案容易出錯、低效率且無法擴充。我們計畫持續投資於銷售與行銷團隊與解決方案開發，以應對來自新客戶的增加需求。此增加的投資將導致費用增加，而在這些投資產生收入之前即已發生。
